name: VRM_MEA_DOC_LINES
description: This is an extension object to document lines that store processing results of all the processes operating on MEAs.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a source document line.

columns.name: PARENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document.

columns.name: MEA_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence identifier of a MEA line.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of a source document items. The valid values are ITEM, MEMO_LINE and ITEM_GROUP.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an item type.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an item inventory organization.

columns.name: REV_COMPLIANCE_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if a revenue complaince process is executed. The initail value is N. Y indicates that the process was run.

columns.name: LINE_UPDATE_STATUS
columns.description: Status indicates if the line has been updated by the user.

columns.name: LINE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag that indicates if the line is a primary MEA or not.  Adjustments are initiated only when primary MEA line is available.  This item is the integral part of the arrangement.

columns.name: PRIMARY_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Primary MEA line number. The revenue adjustments are possible only when the primary line is available.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_ACTION
columns.description: Adjustment action of MEA. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_TRX_ACTION_TYPE and VRM_MEA_LINE_ACTION_TYPE.

columns.name: PRICE_EFF_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a VSOE price effectivity period.

columns.name: UNIT_REVENUE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit revenue price of a line to be recognized by a revenue recognition process.

columns.name: TOTAL_FMV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fair market value line amount of a MEA line.

columns.name: RECOGNIZED_REV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revenue amount which has already been recognized already.

columns.name: DEFERRED_REV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Deferred revenue amount of a MEA line.

columns.name: TOTAL_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount of a MEA line.

columns.name: BILLED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: COMPLIANCE_STATUS
columns.description: Compliance status of a MEA. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_COMPLIANCE_LINESTATUS.

columns.name: POST_ADJ_COMPLIANCE_STATUS
columns.description: Compliance status of a MEA line after a carve out adjustment process.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for a FMV line.

columns.name: MANUALLY_ENTERED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the adjustment amount has been manually entered by the user. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
